Perfect! I've successfully implemented a complete community-moderated comment system for the blog platform. Here's what was added:

## Summary

I've implemented community moderation for post comments with the following components:

### Database & Models
- Created `comments` table (id, post_id, user_id, body, created_at) with cascade delete on post deletion
- Created `comment_reports` table (comment_id, user_id) with unique constraint to prevent duplicate reports
- Added Comment and CommentReport models with proper relationships

### API Endpoints
- **POST /posts/:id/comments** - Create a comment (body: 1-2000 chars, authenticated only)
- **DELETE /comments/:id** - Delete a comment (author or post author only, others get 403)
- **POST /comments/:id/report** - Report a comment (always returns 204, idempotent)

### Frontend
- Updated the posts/Show page to display comments oldest first with author name and timestamp
- Added a comment form for signed-in users (guests are redirected to login)
- Included Report and Delete buttons where appropriate for each comment
- Comments with 3+ reports are automatically hidden from view but preserved in the database

### Moderation Features
- Unique reporting constraint prevents users from duplicating reports
- Comments disappear automatically when 3 different users report them
- Permanent deletion (no soft deletes) when users or post authors remove comments
- Post deletion cascades to remove all associated comments

All code passes `bun test` and `bun run typecheck` with no errors.
